Sceptile

Grass

Hoenn · Generation 3

Sceptile is a Grass-type Forest Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.7 m tall and weighs 52.2 kg. It evolves from Grovyle. Its highest base stat is Speed (120), with a base stat total of 530.
